### Executive Summary
A data breach involving the State Bank of India (SBI) has been reported following public claims made by an undisclosed hacker. The report, originally published by India Today, highlights a potentially significant exposure of customer data.

According to the threat actor's claims, sensitive information belonging to approximately 3.75 lakh (375,000) users is at risk. The compromised data reportedly includes Know Your Customer (KYC) records.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The root cause, attack vector, and exact systems targeted in the reported incident have not yet been confirmed in the available source material. 

If verified, the exposure of KYC records poses a severe confidentiality risk to affected users. Detailed technical impacts and the authenticity of the hacker's claims remain under investigation.

### Mitigation & IOCs
Specific technical mitigations from the organization or regulatory bodies have not yet been confirmed in the source report. Standard advisory measures for sensitive data exposure include monitoring financial accounts for unauthorized transactions and preparing identity-protection measures for affected individuals.
